'''Vhork Leader''' led [[Vhork Squadron]] during the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation of Ossus]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] was considered the best of the [[Hapan Royal Navy]] by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]. Vhork Leader reported that they engaged [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]]s over the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], which was received by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] who relayed the news to Solo. He subsequently led the defense of the evacuees alongside [[Aegel Squadron]], [[Volgh Squadron]], and Vhork Squadron against the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] attackers.
